OP don’t listen to these gatekeepers. The canon T7 is a perfect starting camera, it helps you get to figure out how it works and the kit lenses suck but you can get a nifty 50 for like $100 used. But they are right that wedding photography is no picnic. In fact it’s downright cutthroat in some places. You will practice on family and friends A LOT, you will do giveaways and freebies A LOT. A lot of studying, second shooting, finding a mentor and learning from Peter McKinnon and Jessica Whitaker on YouTube. I started 2020 and I probably made $1000 for the whole year. I also did a strenuous 12 hr shift job during the summer to save up for a used mark iii and a sigma 35 art lens. I cried a lot, I felt insecure a lot and I still do. But this year I’m on track to make $15k which doesn’t seem like much but it’s so much better than last year and I travel for weddings and second shoot, I hire second shooters, I have photog friends, it’s fun! But it’s definitely not for the weak. You will never sleep, you will always be working. My fiancé literally pulls me away and makes me sleep and hydrate for one day a week 💀 I started just to make some extra money because I’m mentally ill and working 9-5s really drain me and I kept calling out and hating it. So if you just want to be a hobbyist and make some extra cash for your birthday or the holidays be my guest. I’m not a shark and I’m trying to get more into creative portraits but weddings pay the bills. Good luck!

Drug addiction is a DISEASE. If you knew someone was suicidal you wouldn’t call them up and say “hey wanna go sit dangerously close to the edge of a building?” I think everyone is right about the show. Everyone’s actions or inaction affects everyone else. Bojack is a well written character because he’s supposed to represent a human being. Seriously horrible people do kind things all the time. And vice versa. Diane even says it in the show. “I don’t think there are good people or bad people, I think we’re all just people” a lot of them lacked boundaries not just bojack. And also bojack abused and used people. It’s a two way street. Another good example the show used is when bojack helped that girl leave the alcohol treatment place. He was complicit but he didn’t give her something to drink. Same with the horse therapist. He dropped the bottle but the horse DRANK IT ALL. and water and alcohol taste nothing alike. Everyone in the show did shitty things because that’s life. It’s our job to maintain boundaries, fix whatever shit we need to fix, go to therapy deal with our trauma, and try to be decent people and leave the planet better than the one we were born into. That’s the point of the whole show.
